name: endothelial PAS domain protein 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: EPAS1 encodes endothelial PAS domain-containing protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and transcription coactivator binding. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to erythrocytosis, familial, 4 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Paraganglioma; Pheochromocytoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
